JOYSTAR Light Up Kids Bike with Training Wheels - Sizes 12", 16", 20"
Inspire outdoor adventure with the KEANO Kids Bicycle. Engineered to build confidence and joy on two wheels, this heavy-duty bike scales flawlessly from a toddler's very first ride to a big-kid cruise, ensuring miles of healthy fun for children aged 3 to 12.

Built tough for today, perfectly adjusted for tomorrow: The KEANO Vellux Kids Bike.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Designed for maximum durability and visibility, the Vellux features a heavy-duty carbon steel frame alongside luminous light effects to keep your child safe."
Safer Riding Features
Safety is the foundational blueprint of the Vellux. The bike features a heavy-duty high carbon steel frame designed to withstand bumps, jumps, and everyday rough-and-tumble play. A **dual brake system** yields rapid, intuitive stopping power, while integrated front and rear fenders block road splashes.

Smooth pedaling and a rigid frame provide stable handling for confident learning.

Child-Friendly Ergonomics

Stunning Light-Up Wheels: Training wheels automatically illuminate when rotating, producing a vibrant, high-visibility flowing light effect.

Full Luminous FX: Dynamic valve lights glow in motion, working together with an under-tube LED strip for spectacular look and nighttime safety.

Full-Coverage Chain Guard: Fully enclosed drivetrain elements completely eliminate pinch hazards and keep small hands and garments clean.

Grows with Your Child: The fully adjustable seat and dynamic handlebars quickly shift to sustain an ergonomic posture as they grow.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Skip the setup headaches. The KEANO Vellux arrives 85% pre-assembled right in the box. We include all specialized tools and step-by-step assembly instructions so your little rider can hit the sidewalk in minutes.
